Order Limits Pro

Ruleworks Software

1,204 reviews

Launched March 2018 · Works with Checkout

Order Limits Pro enforces minimum and maximum order rules by cart value, quantity, weight, product tag or customer tag. Rules run before checkout so merchants never ship an order that loses money. Over 4,100 merchants rely on these rules every day.
